chapter: New York, Dallas and Kansas City
title: Joining Harlan Leonard in Kansas City, replacing Fred Beckett
summary: He took the trombone chair of Fred Beckett and was featured on solos such as 'Stardust'.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So I left Texas to go to Kansas City and I joined Harlan Leonard there.
I see. What were the circumstances of his needing a trombone player?

Fred Beckett was in there for a while and I think he left to go to Lionel Hampton -- I don't remember just what -- I know that Beckett died quite early. But right now, I can't recall, but Fred Beckett was there and I took his place, that's how it was.
Did you get a chance to solo, you know, like a featured soloist with Harlan Leonard? Did you get a chance to solo?
